{'Security researchers have discovered a problem with Apple’s iCloud Private Relay service. While the feature is meant to protect your real IP address, it might actually be leaking it to websites.': '保安研究人員發現 Apple「iCloud 私密轉送」（Private Relay）服務存在漏洞。雖然該功能旨在保護用戶的真實 IP 地址，但實際上可能會將 IP 地址洩露予網站。'}

{'A new iCloud Private Relay problem': 'iCloud 私密轉送新漏洞'}

{'This iCloud Private Relay vulnerability was discovered by security researchers Tommy Mysk and Talal Haj Bakry, who detailed the problem in-depth on their website.': '這個 iCloud 私密轉送漏洞由保安研究人員 Tommy Mysk 及 Talal Haj Bakry 發現，他們已在個人網站詳述問題細節。'}

{'“In short: any website that supports, or pretends to support, passkeys can see the user’s real IP address despite having iCloud Private Relay on,” they say.': '他們指出：「簡而言之，即使已開啟 iCloud 私密轉送，任何支援或假裝支援通行密鑰（passkeys）的網站，仍可看到用戶的真實 IP 地址。」'}

{'As a refresher, iCloud Private Relay is not a VPN. As we’ve explained before, it only protects your IP address in Safari, whereas VPNs protect all traffic from your device by running at the system level.': '溫故知新：iCloud 私密轉送並非 VPN。正如我們先前解釋，它只在 Safari 瀏覽器內保護你的 IP 地址，而 VPN 則在系統層面運作，保護裝置所有流量。'}

{'As 404 Media explains, the problem is due to a series of issues in Apple’s WebKit engine and how it handles passkeys.': '據《404 Media》指出，問題源自 Apple WebKit 引擎的一系列缺陷，以及其處理通行密鑰的方式。'}

{'In a quirk of how passkeys work — a broadly secure alternative to usernames and passwords which use the WebAuthn standard — a user’s device makes a web request outside of the browser itself. Meaning, that request essentially bypasses Private Relay and exposes a user’s real IP address, even though to them it may look like they are simply interacting with a website as normal. “Because the fetch is issued by the operating system’s credential service rather than by Safari, it never enters Private Relay’s proxied path. The destination server sees the device’s real IP address either way,” the researchers write in their research.': '通行密鑰（採用 WebAuthn 標準、屬用戶名稱及密碼以外較安全的替代方案）的運作機制存在奇特之處：用戶裝置會在瀏覽器以外發出網絡請求。換言之，該請求基本上繞過了私密轉送，並暴露用戶的真實 IP 地址，即使從用戶角度來看，他們只是如常與網站互動。研究人員在報告中寫道：「由於該次擷取請求是由作業系統的認證服務發出，而非由 Safari 發出，因此從未進入私密轉送的代理路徑。無論如何，目的地伺服器皆會看到裝置的真實 IP 地址。」'}

{'The impact of the problem is worsened on iOS, where all browsers are required to use Apple’s WebKit engine (in most countries):': '在 iOS 平台上，情況更為嚴峻，因為（在大部分國家）所有瀏覽器均須採用 Apple 的 WebKit 引擎：'}

{'Mysk says they reported the problem to Apple, which said it was “dire.” Nonetheless, the company reportedly didn’t provide a timeline on when the problem will be fixed, but agreed to let Mysk disclose it anyway.': 'Mysk 表示，他們已向 Apple 通報問題，對方回應指情況「嚴峻」（dire）。然而，據報 Apple 並無提供修復時間表，但同意讓 Mysk 公開披露此事。'}

{'You can check whether the problem impacts you via a website set up by the security researchers.': '你可透過研究人員架設的網站，測試自己是否受問題影響。'}

{'Today’s report follows a separate bug impacting Apple’s Hide My Email feature. This vulnerability, which allowed anyone to access a user’s real email address, was fixed by Apple last month.': '今次報告早前，Apple「隱藏我的電郵」（Hide My Email）功能亦曾出現另一漏洞。該漏洞允許任何人取得用戶的真實電郵地址，已於上月由 Apple 修復。'}
